name: node.js-learing
description: This repository is my step-by-step path to learning Node.js from scratch and becoming a junior backend developer. I will start with the JavaScript and command-line basics I need, then learn how Node.js works, build HTTP servers and REST APIs, connect an application to a database, and finish by testing and deploying a complete backend. I will write and run code for every topic, keep my examples in this repository, and move on when I can explain the idea and build a small example without copying a tutorial.
author: eslam ayman
